_notes: Tweak freely. stats are 0-100. timing = base accuracy for AI play; energy = crowd-energy contribution; reliability = resistance to mistakes/buzz drift; mateship = how much they value shouts. model = file in assets/characters (stand-in models are used for members whose likeness ships in Phase 2; tint recolours the stand-in).

members.name: Dave Young
members.blurb: Full send. Climbs anything, sprints through the crowd on a long mic lead.

members.name: Ant Lewis
members.blurb: Energy that keeps building set after set.

members.name: Scotty Woods
members.blurb: The showman. Big solos and the legendary Solo Skull.

members.name: Chris White
members.blurb: Walks out into the crowd on a wireless pack, never drops the groove.

members.name: Steve Smart
members.blurb: Rock solid. Cancels one band mistake per song.

members.name: Dunny
members.blurb: Bass or drums, always the red beret. Loses his groove if it gets knocked off.

members.name: James Huntersmith
members.blurb: The tallest member. Spots canapés and the shortest bar queue from anywhere.

members.name: Hayden Joseph
members.blurb: Blonde, chaotic, lethal with a lemon. Car alarms beware.

members.name: Dave Stockman
members.blurb: Rock solid. Widens the band's timing window and never pulls out sick.

crew.name: Jamie
crew.blurb: Runs the desk. Shout him a beer and your channel goes up.

climb_anything.name: Climb Anything
climb_anything.desc: Mid-song, climb the semi's side rail, a marquee pole or the bar. Higher = bigger Crowd Energy spike, but a fall costs a verse.

crowd_run.name: Crowd Run
crowd_run.desc: Sprint through the crowd on the long mic lead. Untangle it from punters as you go.

pourer.name: Pourer
pourer.desc: Can pour in the Solo Skull.

full_tank.name: Full Tank
full_tank.desc: Crowd-energy bonus grows every song, all gig long.

solo_skull.name: The Solo Skull
solo_skull.desc: During the solo, the singer pours a whole beer into Scotty's mouth while he keeps shredding.

solo_extension.name: Solo Extension
solo_extension.desc: When the crowd's hot, hold the spotlight for extra bars. Overdo it and patties start flying.

into_the_crowd.name: Into the Crowd
into_the_crowd.desc: Walk into the audience on a wireless pack: high-fives and dancing without leaving the rhythm lane.

rock_solid_cancel.name: Rock Solid
rock_solid_cancel.desc: Cancels one band mistake per song.

double_threat.name: Double Threat
double_threat.desc: Can fill the bass OR the drums slot.

beret.name: The Beret
beret.desc: If the red beret gets knocked off, find it. Reduced groove until it's back on.

tall_poppy.name: Tall Poppy
tall_poppy.desc: Sees over any crowd: canapé waitstaff and the shortest bar queue are highlighted.

lemon_launcher.name: Lemon Launcher
lemon_launcher.desc: Grab lemons from the bar and peg them at cars. Streaks build Heat. Max Heat = trouble.

rock_solid_window.name: Rock Solid
rock_solid_window.desc: Widens the band's timing window and resists Buzz drift.

synergies.name: Skull Bros
synergies.desc: Bonus to the Solo Skull: steadier pour, bigger payoff.

synergies.name: Double Trouble
synergies.desc: Both in the crowd at once = big energy multiplier, but the stage is exposed and Scotty must cover.

synergies.name: The Bedrock
synergies.desc: Near-locked band timing. The safe lineup for high-stakes moments.

synergies.name: Beret Beat
synergies.desc: Dunny on drums frees James Huntersmith for bass. Hidden achievement.
